title: Echoes of the Thornwall
author: Narrare Demo
blurb: A young mage must navigate political intrigue between an ancient order and rising rebels while mastering forbidden magic tied to a mysterious relic.

relations.note: Trusts Master Verrick implicitly — perhaps too much. Oblivious to Kaelen's romantic interest. Fears High Chancellor Morven and his increasing inspections. Her discovered Thornwall relic resonates with her void magic in ways she doesn't understand. Has been practicing void magic in secret against Order rules.
